style: Figurative flat illustration for a printed German study book, in the spirit of a mid-century children's picture book with a touch of graphic simplification and a sense of humour: subjects drawn naturally and instantly recognizable, with real proportions and simple friendly faces, details reduced to clean flat colour shapes, medium-weight ink-navy outlines, no gradients, no textures. Limited warm palette: ink-navy, terracotta, mustard, sage, soft blue and cream. The drawing floats on a plain pure white background with generous empty margins on every side; nothing touches the edges of the image, no background colour field, no frame. Food and objects never have faces. No text, no letters, no numbers, no digits, no writing on signs or labels, no watermark. Never write any colour codes, hex values, numbers, labels or signatures anywhere in the picture.

images.prompt: A dreamy picture-book scene: a woman sits on a park bench daydreaming, and above her head a big thought bubble shows three possible lives side by side — herself as an astronaut, as a baker with a giant cake, and lying in a hammock on a beach; a pigeon next to her on the bench has its own small thought bubble with a single bread roll. Natural skin colours.

A family on a balcony separating their rubbish into three bins, a solar panel on the railing and a wind turbine in the distance; the grandfather proudly holds up one single plastic bottle like a trophy while the cat sleeps inside the paper bin. Natural skin colours.

A man in a small flat holding a lottery ticket and daydreaming; a big thought bubble above him shows the same man on a yacht with a captain’s hat, and his dog in the bubble wears sunglasses. In the real room the dog sits beside him with an empty food bowl. Tickets and papers are blank.

A woman running onto a railway platform just as the train leaves, a pigeon sitting on her suitcase; on the platform her flatmate holds up the alarm clock she forgot to set, shrugging. Signs and clock faces have no numbers. Natural skin colours.

An office: a young intern stands on a chair giving orders with a pointing finger and a paper crown, as if he were the boss, while the real boss, an older woman, quietly brings him a cup of coffee and raises an eyebrow. Papers are blank. Natural skin colours.

A front door with an empty doorstep and a man in a dressing gown looking puzzled at it, while in the background a delivery van drives away and a dog runs off happily with the parcel in its mouth. No text on the parcel or the van.

Two neighbours whispering over a garden fence, pointing at a man walking past in a very ordinary jumper carrying a shopping bag; in a little thought bubble above them the same man wears a top hat and sits on a pile of gold coins. Natural skin colours.
A friendly grandmother at a kitchen table pushing a huge cake towards a guest who is already full, holding his stomach; the cat on the chair has cream on its whiskers. Natural skin colours.

A post office counter with a closed shutter and a man outside looking at his wrist watch, while a snail with a tiny parcel on its shell waits patiently next to him. Signs are blank and the watch has no numbers.

A noisy stairwell in an apartment building: on every landing a neighbour is talking, shouting or running about, and on the top floor a man with a book covers his ears; his goldfish in its bowl also covers its eyes with its fins. Natural skin colours.

Two pictures in one scene: on the left a football pitch in pouring rain with the players huddled under one umbrella; on the right the same pitch in sunshine with the ball being chased by a dog. Natural skin colours.

A serious meeting of a company board around a long table; everyone looks at a large chart on the wall, and the chairwoman has to make a decision between two doors at the back of the room, one with a ribbon, one with a cat sleeping in front of it. The chart and doors carry no text or numbers. Natural skin colours.
A city bridge being opened: a mayor cuts a ribbon with huge scissors, a small band plays, and a duck is the first to walk across the new bridge, very proud. Natural skin colours, no text.

A man trying to open a jam jar with all his strength, red in the face, while a small child next to him opens it easily with one twist; the dog waits for the jam. Labels are blank. Natural skin colours.
A sunny, cheerful garden party: a very friendly woman hands out lemonade, a patient man holds a ladder for a cat in a tree, and a child pulls a funny face behaving childishly. Natural skin colours.

A family walking stubbornly through pouring rain on a hiking path, all smiling under raincoats and hoods, and the dog wears tiny rain boots; above them one single black cloud follows only them while the rest of the sky is blue. Natural skin colours.

A map-like picture of a country split in two: the north half under rain clouds with people holding umbrellas, the south half sunny and dry with a person sunbathing and a camel. No text or letters. Natural skin colours.

A cosy bedroom at night: a man sleeps peacefully in a dark, cool room with the curtains closed and his phone left in a drawer, while a cat in the corner is wide awake staring at a glowing tablet. Natural skin colours.

A young woman counting coins from a big piggy bank on a table, and behind her through the window the small old car she has just bought, with a bow on its roof and a squirrel sitting on the bonnet. Natural skin colours.
A schoolroom where a teacher holds up one single pen and asks the class; every child holds up an empty hand except one tiny child at the back holding up a whole box of pens. Natural skin colours.

A woman sitting at a kitchen table writing a letter with a determined face; behind her a washing machine leaks water across the floor and a rubber duck floats past. The letter has only wavy lines. Natural skin colours.
